args: export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; if [ -z "${ATUIN_CONFIG_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.atuin/config.toml" ]; then export ATUIN_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.atuin"; fi; exec atuin mcp
atuin.description: Search synced shell command history and coding-agent threads with Atuin.

rex-community.description: Read-only Rex documentation, changelog, and Rex Beta Discord discussions and feedback

fastmail-read.description: Read-only Fastmail email, contacts, calendars and notes; no compose, send or mutation tools.

paperless-read.description: Read-only Paperless document search, document content and metadata, tags, correspondents and document types.

kubernetes-read.description: Read-only homelab Kubernetes workloads, events, node and Pod metrics, and Pod logs; no Secret or ConfigMap reads, writes, exec or port-forward.

voicenotes-read.description: Read-only Voicenotes semantic note search, note listing, and transcript retrieval; no note creation or mutation tools.

porkbun-read.description: Read-only Porkbun domain, DNS, nameserver, forwarding, account, hosting metadata and documentation queries; no mutations, purchases, payments or credential retrieval.

prometheus-read.description: Read-only homelab Prometheus metrics, PromQL, alerts, rules, targets, status and documentation; no lifecycle, TSDB administration or raw configuration tools.
